purpose: Local feedback policy for improving future job-application runs without formal model training.
nextRunPolicy: Extract the JD before selecting a resume.
Evaluate candidate corpus fit, current market category fit, and JD archetype fit before prioritizing the role.
Run the resume matcher across every local resume version.
Show the recommended resume, runner-up, rationale, and tailoring gaps.
Ask the user for cover-letter positioning before generating text.
Fill application forms only after materials are approved.
Stop at the final review screen and wait for explicit user approval.
Move processed job-alert emails to Codex Job Applications.

stuckPatterns.resolution: Reauthorize with gmail.modify before attempting inbox cleanup.
Pause, summarize current state, and rebuild the resume/materials decision before continuing.

stuckPatterns.pattern: Resume score is inflated by generic keyword overlap
stuckPatterns.resolution: Use archetype fit and tailoring gaps in addition to keyword and concept overlap.

stuckPatterns.pattern: User asks for speed and quality simultaneously
stuckPatterns.resolution: Optimize preparation, but preserve resume matching and final human confirmation.
